text:
Hi there,

I'm getting married and I'm totally falling in love with the idea of hiring your Kestrel for it - I think my partner would absolutely adore it. We were planning on picking it up on September 16, 2027 at 11.30am and bringing it back on 18th September 2027 at 10:30 am. Would you be able to bring it to Hollowmere Abbey? We'd appreciate it if you could collect it from there afterwards. We'd love it if you could bring it with a chauffeur and with ribbons and flowers on the car - can't wait to see the looks on our guests' faces.

Kind regards,
Quentin Penhallow
+70 522 562 7460
